newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares higher, electronics lead.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares higher, electronics lead.

text.p: Singapore shares continued to rise in hectic trading on Thursday with electronic issues leading the way .
Dealers said the rise of electronic shares to new highs was driven by momentum and upbeat sentiment over an expected recovery in the sector in the second half of the year.
Several technology/electronic related stocks touched new year highs, including Acer at US$2.07, Flextech at S$1.90 and Venture at S$5.30.
Soundcard maker Aztech, seen as a laggard in the sector, rose 3.5 cents to S$0.645 with more than 10 million shares traded.
The SES electronics index leaped over four percent to touch a new high of 150.41 before easing slightly to 150.30 at noon, up 6.05 points.
"There is some profit taking but it has been well absorbed," said a broker with a Singapore firm.
